newsitem.title: USA: Natural Health sets deal, eyes acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Natural Health sets deal, eyes acquisitions.

text.p: Natural Health Trends Corp said Friday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Global Health Alternatives Inc.
Terms were not disclosed. Global, through its units, sells natural health care products in the U.S., the United Kingdom and other countries, Natural Health Trends said.
The company said it has an agreement with an investment banking firm to be its financial advisor in connection with possible future acquisitions. The firm was not identified.
Neal Heller, president and chief executive, said the Global acquisition completes the company's three-pronged strategy in the alternative health care industry.

"We will now be the first publicly owned company to train alternative health care professionals, acquire and manage alternative health care practices and, with the Global acquisition, create the distribute innovative products for the alternative health care marketplace," he said.
Natural Health Trends owns and operates schools which offer two-year associate degrees in the alternative health care field, including massage therapy and holistic skin care.
